title: Small-ball mass bounds pass to weak limits of blow-ups at moving centres (Simon 7.3.3(1), displays (6) and (11))
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (z : Euclid P) (r θ₂ ρ₀ : ℝ) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i), 0 < r → 0 ≤ θ₂ → 0 < ρ₀ → ball z (2 * r) ⊆ U → (∀ y ∈ ball z (3 * r / 2), ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → T.massOn (ball y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → (∀ i, xs i ∈ ball z r) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → (∀ (w : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → S.massOn (ball w ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) ∧ ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → θ ≤ θ₂
